text:
Nia (Design): quick check on legend density for the new model-perf dashboard. When there are >6 series the legend wraps and pushes the chart down. Proposal: compact legend mode for dense state (icon + abbrev), reveal full names on hover. thoughts? :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Theo (Frontend): compact legend OK. we'll keep full names in aria-labels. for hover reveal we can use a tooltip or expand-on-hover. prefer expand on click for mobile.
Rina (Product): prefer expand-on-click so mobile behavior consistent. copy for collapsed state: show a badge like "6+" to indicate hidden series.
Nia (Design): badge good. also unit display: tiles should default to "Auto (K/M)" while detailed view uses "Raw". change toggle copy to "Units: Auto | Raw".
Devon (Eng): note on tick snapping: we'll quantize tick marks to human steps (1, 2, 5 * power-of-10). avoids weird decimals like 1.234K. cheap to compute client-side.
Theo (Frontend): smoothing: ops reported monotone spline causing slight undershoot for sudden drops. recommendation: default linear; add "Smoothing: None | Soft" where Soft = spline but explained as "may alter peak values".
Rina (Product): yes default to fidelity over prettiness. include a small "(soft)" pill next to the toggle when enabled.
a11y-bot: accessibility note: collapsed legends must remain keyboard-focusable. ensure touch targets >= 44px on mobile. hairline gridlines <1px may fail contrast — use color tokens that keep contrast >= 3:1.
Nia (Design): thanks @a11y-bot. will provide grid color tokens: grid-small and grid-standard with contrast notes.
Devon (Eng): outliers: two camps — clamp vs show all. Implementation suggestion: clamp by default at 3x IQR for dashboards, add legend menu action "Show full range (includes outliers)". Also add quick expand to zoom to outliers.
Theo (Frontend): UI interaction: legend > kebab menu > "Show full range". For keyboard users, this should be reachable via focus + Enter. aria-label: "Show full chart range, including outliers".
Rina (Product): rollout: dashboards first, leave embeds alone for one release. run an AB test tracking "perceived readability" via a short survey + support mentions of "missing spikes".
Nia (Design): will mock compact legend, badge, and both gridline weights in the kit and tag for design-qa. :white_check_mark:
